description: A utility class for constructing expressions in Apache Spark SQL, including cryptographic functions, string validation, sentence segmentation, and random string generation.

classes.name: ExpressionImplUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for cryptographic operations, string validation, sentence segmentation, and version retrieval in Spark SQL.

methods.name: isLuhnNumber
methods.description: Checks if a given UTF8String represents a valid Luhn number.

methods.name: validateUTF8String
methods.description: Validates a UTF8String according to Unicode rules, throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: tryValidateUTF8String
methods.description: Attempts to validate a UTF8String; returns null if invalid.

methods.name: aesEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input bytes using AES with specified mode, padding, IV, and AAD.

methods.name: aesDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input bytes using AES with specified mode, padding, and AAD.

methods.name: getSparkVersion
methods.description: Returns the current Spark version and revision as a UTF8String.

methods.name: getSecretKeySpec
methods.description: Creates a SecretKeySpec for AES based on key length.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates a random IV based on cipher mode.

methods.name: getParamSpec
methods.description: Returns AlgorithmParameterSpec for cipher modes that require it.

methods.name: aesInternal
methods.description: Performs the core AES encryption/decryption operation with proper initialization and error handling.

methods.name: getSentences
methods.description: Segments a UTF8String into sentences and words based on locale.

methods.name: randStr
methods.description: Generates a random UTF8String of specified length using XORShiftRandom.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Quotes a UTF8String with single quotes, escaping internal quotes.
